conviction_note: Two-sided evidence. On one side is a company that printed above the top of its Q2 AOI and revenue guide, a Q3 AOI guide ($44-47M) that sits low against the FY guide's implied Q4 (~$51M), a 28.1% California rate increase and a CAD tailwind against the guide's FX assumption. On the other side are a peer (Lemonade) whose pet gross loss ratio rose to 75% from 69% this morning, IDEXX US visits worsening to -1.8%, and a +30.7% 20-day run-up that has carried the stock above the $33.25 average target. The short interest is covering but still ~11% of float. impact_sum is -0.3. The scaled number is p_up 48 on a 13% abs move = -0.52; the two measurements agree that the sign is close to a coin flip.
bar: Consensus Q3 2026 revenue $402.2M and EPS $0.16 (Earnings Whispers preview 2026-10-28, https://finviz.com/news/411055/trupanions-pet-growth-faces-a-test-as-guidance-points-to-slower-profit-gains; StockStory/MarketBeat give $402.5M, so two sources agree within $0.3M). Company Q3 guide: total revenue $399-405M, subscription revenue $284-287M, total AOI $44-47M; FY2026 AOI $176-184M ('on track to generate $180 million'), revenue $1.584-1.601B, at a 71% CAD conversion rate (Q2 call transcript 2026-08-05, https://s29.q4cdn.com/621138337/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Trupanion-Q2-2026-Earnings-Call-Transcript.pdf). I found no consensus AOI figure; the stock trades on AOI against the guide.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest 3,676,788 shares at 2026-10-15 settlement, down from 4,059,198 at 2026-09-15 (-9.4%), 9.31 days to cover (equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/trup/shortinterest, read 2026-11-05). stockanalysis gives 10.98% of float and 8.36 days (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/trup/statistics/, updated 2026-11-05). Fintel had 11.85% / 18.99 days on 2026-09-08 (sweep row). That is a crowded short that is being covered into a +30.7% 20-day / +11.8% 5-day run-up (sealed baseline). The baseline's 52-week position is -20.6% from the high. Options: chain unusable (ATM spread 103% of mid), so no skew and no implied move. The put/call OI ratio is 0.32 on only 1,724 contracts. Price $33.74 against an average analyst target of $33.25 (6 analysts; stockanalysis).

findings.finding: Trupanion's own guide pattern points to a Q3 AOI beat. Q2 AOI was $43.3M against a $40-43M guide and revenue was $392.9M against $386-392M, both above the top of the range. Q1 AOI of $40.2M was 'in line' (Q1 guide not re-checked here). The FY guide, $176-184M with 'on track to generate $180 million', less H1 AOI of $83.5M, implies H2 ~$96.5M. A Q3 midpoint of $45.5M therefore implies Q4 ~$51M. A Q3 that only matches the Q2 run-rate plus the July pricing step (finding 2) lands at or above the $47M top of the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When Q2 AOI came in above the top of its guide with the FY low end raised, the stock moved +15.46% (2026-08-05). When Q1 AOI was in line it moved +1.42% (2026-04-30). An adjusted EPS miss in Q3 2025 (2025-11-06) brought -8.34%, and an EPS miss plus profitability worries in Q4 2025 (2026-02-12) brought -13.01%. The stock pays for an AOI beat and punishes a miss.
findings.why_not_priced: The beat history is public and the stock has run 30% into the print, so part of a beat is in the price. Two pieces of evidence for that: the stock now trades above the $33.25 average target, and StockStory notes analysts 'reconfirmed' estimates rather than raising them. Consensus revenue ($402.2M) sits at the guide midpoint, not near the top. It lands inside what the company guided, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 transcript (Q2 guide $40-43M AOI, $386-392M revenue): https://s29.q4cdn.com/621138337/files/doc_financials/2026/q1/Trupanion-Q1-2026-Transcript.pdf. H1 AOI $83.5M from the Q2 8-K exhibit: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001371285/000137128526000171/ex991q22026.htm. Both are company documents.

findings.finding: The California Department of Insurance approved a 28.1% average rate increase for American Pet Insurance Company (Trupanion's CA underwriter), covering 94,326 policyholders (~8% of 1.125M subscription pets). It applies to renewals after 2026-07-19, with some policies rising more than 70%. This follows a 9.5% Georgia increase from 2026-05-01 on 17,465 policyholders. Monthly ARPU was already +9% YoY in Q2 ($87.44). The CA step therefore lifts subscription revenue through Q3 as renewals roll, and it carries a retention risk on the largest rate shock in the book (trailing retention 98.37%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A June 2023 CA/NY rate approval sent the stock up double digits on the day (TipRanks 2023-06-23). In the Q4 2025 print, analysts' questions on whether pricing could be sustained against vet inflation came with -13.01%.
findings.why_not_priced: The filing was public before the Q2 call, so the company built it into its Q3 subscription revenue guide ($284-287M, +13%). What is not visible is the retention response to a 28% average hike. If the market had priced a retention problem, the stock would not be up 30% into the print with shorts covering.
findings.independence: Georgia 9.5% increase from 2026-05-01, 17,465 policyholders: https://insurify.com/pet-insurance/news/georgia-pet-insurance-hikes (2026-03-04). The Q2 call says vet inflation is 'still at the double-digit level' and is flowing through pricing.

findings.finding: Lemonade's Q3 2026 shareholder letter (8-K filed 2026-11-05, before the market opened; this is the first pet-insurance print since Trupanion spoke) shows a Pet gross loss ratio of 75%, against 74% in Q2 2026 and 69% in Q3 2025. Pet premium per customer rose to $854 from $782. On this evidence vet cost trend was still outrunning pricing at a direct competitor in Q3. Trupanion's equivalent 'value proposition' (vet invoices as % of subscription revenue) was 70.2% in Q2, against 71.1% a year earlier. Every 1pt on that line is ~$2.85M of Q3 AOI, ~6% of the guide midpoint. LMND stock was ~-11% intraday today.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 (-13.01%): vet inflation fears and profitability. Q2 2026 (+15.46%): value proposition improved to 70.2% from 71.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: It came out this morning. TRUP traded flat intraday today (33.85 vs 33.67) while LMND fell ~11%, so the market has seen it and has not marked TRUP down. It may read Lemonade's young, fast-growing book (Pet IFP +53%) as a different claims profile. That is a reasonable reading, and it is why this is sized below the line's potential.
findings.independence: Trupanion's own Q2 call: vet inflation 'still at the double-digit level... has come down', with clinics pushing price while wellness visits fall (https://s29.q4cdn.com/621138337/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Trupanion-Q2-2026-Earnings-Call-Transcript.pdf). LMND price from Yahoo chart: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/LMND?range=10d&interval=1d.

findings.finding: IDEXX's Q3 2026 call (2026-11-02) estimated US same-store clinical visits at -1.8%, worse than -1.3% in Q2, with puppy/kitten adoption 'more muted'. Zoetis's Q3 2026 10-Q (2026-11-05) puts US companion animal products down $89M on 'softer end-market demand'. Trupanion enrolls mainly through vet hospitals and flagged on the Q2 call a 'downturn in new visits to veterinarians'. A worsening visit trend weighs on Q3 gross adds, net pet adds (18,800 in Q2) and the Q4 enrollment commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Net subscription pet adds of 18,800 (+39% YoY) were part of the +15.46% Q2 reaction. In Q3 2025 (-8.34%), total enrolled pets were -2% YoY.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock rose ~8% on 2026-11-04, after IDEXX's call, so the market has not marked pet funnel names down on it. Management had pre-flagged the visit headwind, which makes this a partly priced proxy. Fewer visits can also lower claims frequency, which cuts the other way on the loss line.
findings.independence: Zoetis Q3 2026 10-Q, US companion animal -$89M on softer end-market demand: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001555280/000155528026000050/zts-20260930.htm. Both are industry proxies, not Trupanion's own number.

findings.finding: The Q3 guide was set at a 71% USD/CAD conversion rate (Q2 call). The Canadian dollar traded around 0.72 USD through Q3: USD/CAD ~1.38-1.40 in August-September samples, with the 2026 low of 0.7024 on 2026-06-24. That gives a small revenue tailwind on the Canadian book relative to the guide, roughly +1.4% on Canadian revenue, i.e. well under 1% of total revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated; the company calls out FX in every guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Too small to be priced either way. Analysts may already have adjusted revenue estimates for it, since consensus is $402.2M against the $402M guide midpoint.
findings.independence: ValutaFX daily rates, e.g. 2026-08-27 USD/CAD 1.3853: https://www.valutafx.com/history/cad-usd-2026-08-27. The 71% assumption is in the Q2 transcript.

findings.finding: The stock went into the print up +30.67% over 20 days and +11.76% over 5 days (sealed baseline; $24.57 on 2026-10-05 to $33.74). No company-specific catalyst was found: no 8-K since 2026-08-05, and Simply Wall St (2026-10-30) names no cause. Price is now above the $33.25 average analyst target, Cantor cut its target to $30 on 2026-10-07, and sentiment shifted 'mildly bullish to moderately bearish' per Earnings Whispers. Short interest fell 9.4% from 4.06M to 3.68M shares between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-15, so part of the run is covering that is now spent. That raises the bar to a clean beat plus a firm FY. Against that, ~11% of float and ~9 days to cover remain as squeeze fuel on a beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two negative prints of the last four (Q3 2025 -8.34%, Q4 2025 -13.01%) came on misses of the adjusted/EPS line. The +15.46% Q2 move came from a lower base, below the 200-day moving average.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself. The claim is that the run-up has already used the 'beat' outcome, so the reaction to an in-line or modest beat is skewed down. The crowded short is the reason this is sized small rather than large.
findings.independence: Run-up and price vs target: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/trup/statistics/ and https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/insurance/nasdaq-trup/trupanion/news/trupanion-trup-heads-into-earnings-with-an-undervalued-case (2026-10-30). Cantor target cut: https://www.cnn.com/markets/stocks/TRUP (date garbled on page).

findings.finding: Trupanion authorized a $100M buyback with no expiry (board approval June 2026, announced 2026-08-05) and received NYDFS approval in July for a $44M extraordinary dividend from APIC. It had ~$100M of available operating cash after that dividend, and the stock traded $23-25 through September and early October, its lows. The company repurchased nothing in H1. Any Q3 repurchase is first disclosed in this release or the 10-Q, and Q3 repurchases fall inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback was announced with Q2 (+15.46%). It was one of several positives, so its share of that move is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether and how much was bought is unknown. CFO Qureshi said repurchases would be 'opportunistic' and IRR-based against pet acquisition spending, so a zero is possible. This is an inference and sized small.
findings.independence: Q2 transcript Q&A (Josh Shanker, BofA) on whether the buyback will be used: https://s29.q4cdn.com/621138337/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Trupanion-Q2-2026-Earnings-Call-Transcript.pdf. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: Insider selling continues in small 10b5-1 sizes. The COO sold 431 shares at ~$29.12 on 2026-10-28 ($12.5k; holds 32,880). Form 4/144 pairs were filed roughly every two weeks from August to October, with no insider purchases.
findings.why_not_priced: Routine plan sales of trivial size carry no information about the quarter. Filed for completeness.

baseline_tension: There is no usable skew. The 30.7% run-up to above the analyst target cuts against the company's beat pattern and the pricing step, and agrees with the Lemonade loss-ratio read and the visit softness. Net, the evidence leaves the sign near 50/50, and the stock's own history says the move will be large either way.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (inside the guide): the AOI-beat finding moved from +1.0 to +0.8 and the CA rate-increase finding from +0.5 to +0.3, because both land inside what the company guided.

Lesson 5 (proxy vs direct): the Lemonade loss ratio is a direct peer print after Trupanion last spoke, so it stays filed, but it moved from -1.0 to -0.8 because TRUP was flat on it today. IDEXX/Zoetis visits are a proxy the company pre-flagged, moved from -0.5 to -0.4.
Lesson 7 (crowded short): the run-up/positioning negative moved from -1.0 to -0.8 for ~11% of float short and ~9 days to cover.
Lesson 5 (inference): the buyback finding moved from +0.5 to +0.4.
Lesson 8 (understatement): abs_move_pct raised from 12 to 13 (the name's median reaction); p_up 47 to 48 because the caveats on both sides pull toward 50. impact_sum is unchanged at -0.3.
